metadata.title: Statement Analyzer
metadata.summary: Import bank statements and instantly understand your spending through automatic categorization, beautiful charts and meaningful financial insights.
metadata.overview: A personal finance companion that automatically analyzes bank statements, categorizes transactions and transforms raw financial data into meaningful insights through beautiful visualizations.
metadata.why: Managing personal finances shouldn't require manually going through hundreds of transactions. I wanted to build a tool that could instantly tell the story hidden inside a bank statement while helping me learn data visualization and financial analytics.
